| Issue | Root Cause | Fix |
|-------|-----------|-----|
| **Validation runs 6× instead of 3×** | Two item groups in one task = cross-product | Target-level batching via `Outputs="%(ProtoFile.Identity)"` + `@()` transform for rules |
| **CS2002 duplicate warnings** | Explicit `Compile Include="**\*.g.cs"` overlaps SDK glob + target addition | Replaced with `DefaultItemExcludes` for intermediate path; Compile added only inside the target |
| **Clean removes too many files** | `Remove="**\*.g.cs"` matches all `.g.cs` (including source like `Constants.g.cs`) | Scoped to only proto-generated files via item transform + `Delete` task |
| **FileWrites not tracked across builds** | Static ItemGroup evaluated outside target context | Moved `FileWrites` inside `GenerateProtoCode` target |
